name: Termination lane
event_description: employee terminations effective in the period

nodes.description: HR system of record emitting termination events
central IdP fanning deprovisioning out to downstream systems
cloud IAM principals, incl. break-glass accounts
initiates termination in the system of record

edges.trigger: termination event propagates to IdP deactivation

control_points.statement_template: every terminated employee was deactivated in {system}'s downstream IdP

assertions.description_template: a deactivation event exists in the IdP for each termination in {system}
IdP deactivation occurred within 5 business days of the {system} termination

control_points.statement_template: no terminated employee retains access in {system}, including local and group-derived accounts

assertions.description_template: no terminated identity appears among {system} access holders after the revocation window
{system} access was revoked within 5 business days of termination
